brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: Bases at level 0 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) and level 1 (piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full) connected with snaps
drawer:0#0,1#cut in half-s base piece:0,1,0;half-s on level 0

Capped 8 outer edges (0,0,0;90/150, 0,0,1;150/210, 1,0,1;30/90/210/330) and locked joints. Remaining open faces at 0,0,0;270 and 1,0,0;210/270 etc are refused by configurator (MESH_CLASH with drawer runner/frame) so cannot be fully capped while retaining drawer.

finish.summary: Built 2-cell two-storey organizer with two full bins on upper storey and a drawer on lower front, capped all edges the configurator allows and locked joints; edges immediately adjacent to drawer cannot be capped due to mesh clash with drawer hardware.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
